title: Fizz Buzz
description: Return an array of strings representing numbers from 1 to n, replacing multiples of 3 with 'Fizz', 5 with 'Buzz', and both with 'FizzBuzz'.
pseudocode:
1. result = []
2. for i = 1 to n:
3.   if i % 15 == 0: result.push('FizzBuzz')
4.   else if i % 3 == 0: result.push('Fizz')
5.   else if i % 5 == 0: result.push('Buzz')
6.   else: result.push(i.toString())
